lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Find the volume of a 6-by-2-by-3 cube prism.

FEEDBACK
36 cubic units.

WATCH FOR
Adding the three dimensions instead of multiplying gives a length-like total, not volume.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Calculate volumes for fourteen cube prisms. Show base × height layers for seven.

Write a short reflection naming one step you corrected and why.
